fusions.name: Waiting Strike
fusions.desc: A coiled strike that deals 9 damage and makes the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds. It needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up.

fusions.name: Venom Spread
fusions.desc: Every enemy within 3.5 tiles takes 8 damage and is [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on each target spread to enemies within 4.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Coiled Tension
fusions.desc: Increases your critical damage by 40% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Warm Side
fusions.desc: When you inflict a condition, you heal for 20% of the damage you deal for 6 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
